desktop.notes: • Select several albums in the sidebar like in Explorer: Ctrl+click adds / removes one, Shift+click a run. Right-click them: add the selected photos to all, Send their photos to Library, copy them to a folder, or delete them all (the photos always stay). Deletes reach the Library at once, so Curish and the other apps drop those albums too.
